title: Clinic support must respect operational windows

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: Reception problems are urgent when patients are waiting, but we cannot restart systems whenever we like. Vendors handle clinical software and devices. An intermittent problem disappeared during a short visit and returned next morning. We need useful notes without patient details.
retrieve_on.workflow_context: Seven staff supporting clinic office IT, printers, networks and backups; clinical devices excluded.

discriminating_questions.question: Which service is in our scope?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Reception PCs and network, not clinical equipment.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: A vendor outage or clinical-device failure needs routing to the responsible supplier, not an invented IT repair procedure.

discriminating_questions.question: Who authorizes interruption?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: The practice manager coordinates acceptable downtime.
discriminating_questions.diagnostic_value: Work timing is an approval constraint.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: What evidence reproduces the fault?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Time, workstation and error code help; patient screenshots are unnecessary.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.question: Was disappearance treated as resolution?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Yes, although no cause was found.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

positive_mechanism: Scope, interruption authority and intermittent-fault evidence are missing from triage and closure criteria.
counterexample: A vendor outage or clinical-device failure needs routing to the responsible supplier, not an invented IT repair procedure.
minimum_evidence: A simulated support agreement excludes clinical equipment.
A simulated visit has no reproduction or confirmed fix.
A simulated manager note restricts restart timing.
process_intervention: Record operational impact using non-patient information; identify the authorized coordinator and approved work window; retain monitoring follow-up.
automation_candidate: Guide privacy-minimizing intake, scope routing and authorization tracking; draft updates without clinical details.
unknowns: Customer privacy procedures, criticality and exact authorization policy need local confirmation.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Operational-window and privacy controls require explicit engineering and customer review.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
